titles.title: A bill to amend the Social Security Act to provide for transfers from the general fund of the Treasury to the Federal Old-Age and Survivors Insurance Trust Fund in order to ensure full payment of Social Security benefits, and for other purposes.

A bill to amend the Social Security Act to provide for transfers from the general fund of the Treasury to the Federal Old-Age and Survivors Insurance Trust Fund in order to ensure full payment of Social Security benefits, and for other purposes.
